name: Honora Connole
bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives her husband as William J. Dailey (b. Minersville 17 Feb 1854, d. Wilkes-Barre 18 Jan 1931, son of Michael Dailey and Elizabeth Keating) and lists eleven children, among them Elizabeth A. (1877-1958), Honora (1878-1961), Anna Hilary (1880-1951), Michael (1882-1902), Dr. Thomas Joseph (1884-1934), Gertrude F. (1890-1929), Loretta Alberta (1891-1967), Theressa Rosalind (1893-1985) and Margaret (1895-1987) (S1, S2).

conflicts.assessment: FS attaches an 1860 census and a death/burial record; prefer 1854 pending.
